title: Golden Age Illustration Exhibit on Long Island
content: Clockwise from U.L.: Norman Rockwell, Dean Cornwell,Maxfield Parrish, Tom LovellComing up December 10, 2016 is an exhibition of Golden Age American illustration called "Norman Rockwell and Friends: American Illustrations from the Mort Künstler Collection." The exhibit, in Huntington, NY, is borrowed from the collection of illustratorMort Künstler.Mr. Künstler's collection is featured in an article in the new issue (#54) ofIllustration Magazine.The magazine also takes a look at the science fiction illustrations of Frank R. Paul (1884-1963) in a profile written by David Saunders. The final feature examines the pioneering illustration work by the Waud brothers, who produced illustrations of the Civil War.The exhibition is at theHeckscher Museumin Huntington, New York on Long Island, and it will be on view through March 5, 2017.Previously:The Action Art of Mort Künstler.
